description: This file provides a support class for JPA data access objects, encapsulating common CRUD operations, query building, filtering, sorting, and entity management functionalities using JPA and Spring annotations.

classes.name: SalesManagerJpaDaoSupport
classes.description: A support class for JPA data access objects, providing methods for CRUD operations, query building, filtering, sorting, and entity management with Spring and JPA.

methods.name: buildTypedQuery
methods.description: Creates a TypedQuery with optional limit and offset for pagination.

methods.name: filterCriteriaQuery
methods.description: Applies a filter expression to a CriteriaQuery if it is not null.

methods.name: rootCriteriaQuery
methods.description: Creates a root element for a CriteriaQuery based on the class.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieves an entity by class and ID.

methods.name: getByField
methods.description: Fetches an entity by a specific field value.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an entity in the database, merging if detached.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an entity from the database.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the state of an entity from the database.

methods.name: listEntity
methods.description: Lists entities with optional filtering, ordering, limit, and offset.

methods.name: listEntityByField
methods.description: Lists entities filtered by a specific field value.

methods.name: countEntity
methods.description: Counts total entities of a class.

methods.name: countEntityByField
methods.description: Counts entities filtered by a specific field value.

methods.name: getSingleResultOrNull
methods.description: Executes a criteria or typed query and returns a single result or null if none.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sorts a list of entities in-place using their natural ordering.
